author: Steve Watts
description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a faithful remake, but that doesn't mean it can't pack a few surprises. Between updates and modernizations, and just the way some new systems interact, there are a fair number of secrets and strange interactions to uncover throughout the land of Hyrule.

Some of these were there in the original and have been kept intact, while others have been updated to have slightly different effects. Then there are some that are new to this version of the game, ready for curious adventurers to uncover. We've rounded up 25 of them below, and there are surely still many more to discover.
title: We Bet You Didn’t Know All 25 Of These Things About Ocarina Of Time

author: Ben Janca
description:
Ocarina Of Time Remake has a vast amount of both old and new secrets. We uncover many of them, including a jump mechanic that's actually an old demo mechanic, hidden dialogue dependent on your approach with a NPC, and a brand new detail that turns one of the guards into a complete jerk.

Ocarina Of Time Spaceworld Demo Jump Button-

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Modern Warfare 4 has integrated with Warzone for Season 1, bringing new maps, modes, and game mechanics to Call of Duty's battle royale. The season introduces a brand-new training mode called Rally Point, which oddly enough, also lets players buy the game-ending nuke killstreak that's normally reserved for multiplayer. This is the first time Warzone has let players buy a nuke, but this seems like an odd choice for a training ground designed to allow players the space to learn, as sweaty players are joining the lobby just to nuke them.

Warzone's Rally Point takes place on the new Zodiac Resurgence map as a casual game mode with a mix of 20 players and bots. There is no time limit or circle collapse, so it doesn't play quite like a traditional match, but it means players are free to take their time and explore the entirety of the map. Respawns are also unlimited, so everyone can die and respawn as much as they want.
title: CoD: Warzone’s New Intro Mode Lets Players Buy A Nuke, Which Isn’t Very Beginner-Friendly

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19. If you're planning to buy the $80 edition but want to upgrade later to the $100 version, you might be interested to know if such a thing is possible.

Thankfully, yes, it is-and it's very easy to do.

Rockstar will offer an "Ultimate Edition Upgrade" for $20, so for anyone who buys the $80 version and decides they do want the additional perks, they can upgrade. This applies to both the digital edition of GTA 6 that you can buy from the Xbox and PlayStation stores, as well the code-in-a-box physical edition.
title: Can You Upgrade To GTA 6’s $100 Edition? Yes, And It’s Easy–Here’s How

author: Tom Caswell
description:
Like many people who have watched Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s masterful documentary You Can See Everything, I sat down with my friend after our screening to bounce our thoughts off of one another. The film revolves around convicted felon Elizabeth Holmes, the former CEO of Theranos who was criminally indicted for defrauding investors, and her husband Billy Evans, who met her some time after the charges against Holmes were made, picking up their story a month before her incarceration.

The documentary is about a lot of things, but at its core, the main question it posits is whether Holmes is a master manipulator or is being masterfully manipulated by the men in her life, with multiple parallels drawn between her husband Evans and her former partner, both romantically and in business at Theranos, Ramesh "Sunny" Balwani. 

At the end of the conversation I was havin
title: Looking at Xbox, You Can See Everything

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Following the US midterm elections this week, shares of Nvidia--the world's No. 2 most valuable company by market cap behind Apple--slid downhill in a big way. In fact, more than $1 trillion has been wiped out from Nvidia's market cap since its peak in October.

Nvidia stock rebounded today, November 6, following the huge selloff on November 5 that also affected numerous other AI and technology stocks. However, Nvidia is still lagging behind Krispy Kreme in terms of growth in 2026.
title: Donuts Beat AI: Nvidia Has Lost $1 Trillion+ In The Past Month, While Krispy Kreme Surges

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is gearing up for a second year of action, and while you can expect new courses, modes, and characters to join the game, the real headline act here is the new cars coming to it. As part of the Sega Consoles Pack, players will be able to tear around courses while driving a four-wheeled Sega video game console, with each vehicle expertly blending the design of that classic gaming hardware into a lean-and-mean racing machine.

The new cars are based on the Sega Genesis (or Mega Drive for anyone who lived outside the US), the Sega Saturn, and Sega's final home console, the Dreamcast. According to the Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds development team, the idea was to incorporate design elements that would instantly remind players of each console into their respective vehicle frames, like the round
title: You Can Finally Drive A Dreamcast, Thanks To Sonic

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Season 1 of Modern Warfare 4 adds a brand-new DMZ map, but it isn't accessible from the menus. In this DMZ guide, we'll show you how to find the entrance to X01 on Hajin, and we'll provide some tips to help you survive this new extraction experience in Modern Warfare 4.

What is the X01 map in MW4 DMZ mode?
title: There’s A New DMZ Map Hidden In MW4, And Here’s How To Find It

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
This year's annual Mass Effect Day looks to be somber in light of the studio behind the games, BioWare, being shut down last month. But while no new Mass Effect games are currently on the horizon, you can celebrate its legacy through some classy art prints that are going up for sale ahead of N7 Day. Preorders for the Mass Effect Collection will begin on Friday, November 6, at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET / 6 PM BST on the Moor-Art website.

The Mass Effect Collection

title: Mass Effect Is Getting A New Art Collection At A Difficult Time For Its Fans

description:
Modern Warfare 4 integrates with Warzone for Season 1, adding MW4's full weapon pool, attachments, and other new gear into battle royale. The big update also overhauls Warzone's perk system, including the introduction of the powerful new "Elite" perks. In this guide, we'll explain how perks work for this new year of Warzone and include some recommended picks for your next match.

How perks work in Warzone for MW4

title: The Best Warzone Perks May Surprise You After The MW4 Overhaul

author: Ben Janca
description: Ultron crashing Emma Frost's Hellfire Gala in Marvel Rivals Season Two introduced a lot of drama. Let's catch up on what happened.
title: Marvel Rivals: The Story So Far

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It's the smallest details that stand out most in Grand Theft Auto 6, and thanks to all the screenshots that developer Rockstar Games has posted since the game was officially announced, there's been no shortage of stuff to analyze. Last week, senior video producer Jake Dekker grabbed all 99 of those official screenshots--with the number of images increasing this week thanks to a new screenshot dump--and started going through each and every single one of them.

He found plenty of cool little secrets hidden in each image, from legal tender celebrating paranoia to surprisingly realistic flesh, and this week, he's back with another look at GTA 6's impressive attention to detail. Some of these includ
title: GTA 6 Is Going All Out On Details You Might Never Even Notice

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Sony Interactive Entertainment and French developer Oh BiBi have announced Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble, a phone and tablet game, is coming to a close before it was even released fully.

In a statement, the developers said the game's final update is coming today, November 6, and the game itself will be removed from digital stores on November 21, 2026.

No information was provided as to why Ranger Rumble is shutting down. The game soft-launched in 2025 in limited territories, and expanded to more markets, but it's no longer going ahead with a full global release.

People who already have the game installed can keep playing until May 1, 2027, which is when the game's servers permanently close. Once the servers are shut down, the game will be co
title: Ratchet & Clank Game Shutting Down Before Ever Fully Launching

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Strauss Zelnick, the head of Rockstar Games owner Take-Two, is known for his dedication to health and fitness. In 2018, he published a book titled Becoming Ageless: The Four Secrets To Looking and Feeling Younger Than Ever, and images of the executive looking shredded and lean at 8% body fat have circulated online. Zelnick has now spoken more about his health and fitness lifestyle, and offered some advice for people who want to get in shape and feel better.

Zelnick started off by telling Business Insider that he's good friends with Brya
title: Head Of GTA 6 Owner Reveals His Advice To Be Healthy, Fit, And Live A Long Time

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Hideo Kojima's Physint has a leading man in Bill Skarsgård, and the Hollywood actor recently spoke more about his part in the game. Billed as a spiritual successor to Kojima's Metal Gear Solid franchise, Physint is an action-espionage game that features Skarsgård alongside several other actors, like Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe. Skarsgård's love for the Metal Gear Solid franchise and a chance to work with Kojima proved to be the deciding factors in taking on the role of the unnamed Physint protagonist.

"I played every single one," Skarsgård said to Josh Horowitz on the Happy Sad Confused podcast. "Starting from the one on PlayStation One all the way to the last one. I was very enamored by him [Kojima], the mythology
title: Bill Skarsgard Didn’t Need Much Convincing To Join Hideo Kojima’s Physint

author: Callum Self
description:
Mario Kart World may be one of my favorite games from last year, but as the only person with a Nintendo Switch 2 in my family, Mario and co. are sitting there, gathering dust and waiting for an excuse to be played. Now you have even less reason to race down Rainbow Road because its best alternative is on sale. I personally think Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds may be one of the best kart racers on the market. Sorry, my Italian plumber friend, maybe another day.

Of course, I’m being a bit dramatic—Mario Kart is still fun. But Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds benefits from a lightning-fast pace that makes every race pump adrenaline through my veins. And, eventually, yours too. As you race across each track, you’ll eventually find yourself at one of two giant rings before being taken across the multiverse and dropped into differen
title: Your New Favorite Mario Kart Rival On PC Is Cheaper Than Ever

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Nier Automata is my favorite game of all time, and I've been telling everyone I know to play it for nearly a decade. On PC, however, Square Enix accidentally made that a little bit more difficult, because the game's latest patch ballooned the game's file size by more than 600%.

The update, tested by RPG Site, takes what was a pretty reasonable 50GB file size and raises it to 366GB. It appears to be incorrectly assigning a file size of more than 40GB to each piece of DLC. The patch itself was supposed to simply add three new languages to the Steam version: Sim
title: Nier Automata’s File Size Now Reflects How Good It Is

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
2024's Borderlands movie was a massive flop at the box office, and Take-Two's CEO has now reacted to this, readily acknowledging, "We failed."

Speaking at Business Insider Live, Strauss Zelnick said Take-Two's mission is to "make the best entertainment on Earth," and with the Borderlands film, the company failed to meet that mark.

He said the company "tried incredibly hard" on the Borderlands movie, and pointed out that Take-Two didn't actually lose any money on it because Lionsgate funded it. "But I am here to tell you, it was not the best entertainment on Earth. We failed," he said.

The Borderlands movie featured a stacked cast of big names, including Cate Blanchett as Lilith, Kevin Hart as Roland, Jack Black as the
title: “We Failed,” Take-Two Boss Says Of The Mega-Flop Borderlands Movie

author: Evan Campbell
description:
We should acknowledge that Monolith Soft isn't just a Xenoblade developer, but also a major supporter of The Legend of Zelda franchise. The studio confirmed on X that it assisted with programming and graphics (per a machine translation) on the Ocarina of Time remake. This marks the fifth time the team has contributed to a mainline Zelda title, starting with 2011's Skyward Sword. 

There were a lot of theories in the past couple of months about what team was behind The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2--especially considering the v
title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Involved Xenoblade Chronicles Creator Monolith Soft

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
There's no denying that Stellar Blade is one seriously good-looking game. On Switch 2, it runs surprisingly well on Nintendo's hybrid system, and it'd be a perfect port if it wasn't for one glaring issue that holds it back.

On the surface, Stellar Blade looks like a smooth port with few compromises, as it still offers plenty of graphical detail at a lower resolution. Stellar Blade on Switch 2 also targets 60fps, but in order to achieve that, it uses a very aggressive form of frame generation to create a smooth sense of action. The problem with this is that it makes the game harder to play, because your actions are delayed.
title: Stellar Blade On Switch 2 Looks Like A Great Port, Until You Start Fighting

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Unity Software is reportedly being eyed as the next acquisition by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and a consortium of investors, including US private equity firm Silver Lake Partners. According to Reuters, Unity is already in talks with interested parties, with the software company reportedly valued as high as $25 billion, a significant increase from its current public price of $21.5 billion following its latest earnings report.

Silver Lake already owns 8% of Unity, and talks are said to be in place as Unity considers the best options moving forward. If the company is sold, it'll represent another major investment by Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund and partners into the gaming industry, following the recent acquisition of Electronic A
title: After EA, Saudi Arabia Is Reportedly Setting Its Sights On One Of Gaming’s Biggest Engines
